purpose: Cross-slice linkage audit after P13 and M2–M6 content maturation, including the claim-level telecommunications ↔ energy resilience dependency.

coverage.relation_contract: Each cross-slice Relation has explicit frame_ref, no Relation participant, and at least two participants.
coverage.corpus_scope: Current working corpus through M6 post-correction maturation; the M5 telecommunications-energy relation remains included and claim-level endpoints are explicit. M6 Relation audit found no M6 target references, no confirmed broken endpoints, and no duplicate unordered participant pair.

findings.basis: Six P13 settlement relations were added only where a direct conceptual or dependency linkage is substantive: settlement ↔ housing, infrastructure, transportation, water infrastructure, energy systems, and public health.
The added P13 and M2 relations use the existing cross-slice contract: explicit frame_ref, no Relation participant, and two claim participants. No duplicate relation was introduced.
The added relations expose bounded conceptual or dependency linkage without asserting unsupported causal direction and preserve the evidence epistemic boundary.
Six M3 relations were identified only where direct conceptual or dependency linkage is material; no metric-only linkage was introduced.

A single telecommunications-continuity ↔ energy-grid-resilience Relation was added because both Claims describe a direct critical-infrastructure dependency; it uses the existing relation contract and explicit shared frame.

conclusion.next_step: Complete M6 post-correction substantive, evidence-independence, Human View/adversarial, and Relation sign-off; then run Reference tests, Release Conformance Gate, and Offline Edition on the same exact final M6 HEAD and independently verify the CLEAN checkpoint.

epistemic_boundary: Relations, conformance and provenance do not establish truth and do not replace independent evidence.
